relationships.subject: P2X7
relationships.evidence_quote: P2X<sub>7</sub> receptors can activate the NLRP3 inflammasome, which, in turn, induces IL-1β release and activates the COX pathway, generating an inflammatory cycle

relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: P2X<sub>7</sub> receptors can activate the NLRP3 inflammasome, which, in turn, induces IL-1β release and activates the COX pathway, generating an inflammatory cycle

relationships.subject: P2X4
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of the P2X4 receptor triggers calcium influx and p38 MAPK phosphorylation, leading to cytosolic PLA2 (cPLA2) activation and COX-dependent PGE2 release.

key_findings: Review: ATP/P2X receptors and bioactive lipids (prostaglandins, leukotrienes, resolvins) form an inflammatory loop; P2X4 in neuropathic pain, P2X7 drives NLRP3/IL-1β.
